correctness.rationale: At every fixed positive arc, the exact near-diameter line chord reduces to two adjacent circular constraints. A matched boundary layer gives epsilon[one-half log(1/epsilon)+log(sin ell)+one-half]+o(epsilon) per signed side. Sum over arc sectors, normalize by Barbier perimeter pi, and use strict Jensen plus Taylor stability. The proof checks endpoint strips and fixed-polygon quantifiers. Exact all-disk numerical tests passed 53 assertions for four regular examples, corroborating rather than substituting for analytic arguments.
